# Vendored dependencies

## Apache ECharts

- Package: `echarts`
- Version: `6.1.0`
- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/echarts/v/6.1.0
- Runtime file: `echarts.min.js`
- License: Apache License 2.0
- License text: `ECHARTS-LICENSE.txt`
- Notice: `ECHARTS-NOTICE.txt`

The browser bundle is committed locally so the extension can render charts without
loading code from a CDN or requiring a local development server.
